contract.sync_assumed: all lanes of the hardware warp call the primitive together (the logical warps of a sub-warp instantiation run in lockstep)
contract.sync_performed: shuffles, ballots and one redux on the full warp mask, no barrier
contract.k_range: [1, N] with MaxK = max(LW, next_pow2(k)) dividing N and N / MaxK a power of two, the truncated merge applies to power of two k (other k take the full merge), k 4 to 64 measured
contract.n_range: N = LW x IPT with MaxK dividing N, measured 32 to 256 at LW 32
contract.type_constraints: fp32 keys only, twiddled to an order-preserving u32 word, the index is never carried through the network and is recovered from the item's position by ballot rank
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN twiddles above +inf (positive sign) or below -inf (negative sign) and is selected or dropped deterministically by its sign bit, never produced by focus-set inputs. -0.0 is mapped to +0.0 before the twiddle so the two zeros are one word
contract.tie_break_support: prefer_smaller_index exact by construction (items above the k-th word in index order, then the tied items in index order until k), the same code serves not_guaranteed at the same cost
contract.sorted_output_support: not provided: the final merge stops at stride k, the output is the selected set in class and index order
